text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...How strange. I could have sworn I 
heard someone calling for me..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Could this be... a revelation from the 
Goddesses?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Chosen by the Goddess to power up...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It sounds fun, but... it's not going to be 
like an anime, right—
